release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.8.8 Release — Permission Setup Refinement & Session Stability:
• Clarified Permission Hierarchy: Highlighted that core app blocking, focus timers, and curfews require only the 3 standard permissions (Usage Access, Display Over Apps, Notifications) and do NOT require the 3-dot Restricted Settings menu.
• Optional YouTube Filter Architecture: Dedicated guidance for the optional YouTube Shorts filter on Android 13/14+ sideloaded installations with direct 1-tap App Info access.
• Rock-Solid Session Persistence: Credit-unlocked app sessions persist cleanly across app-switching and back gestures without premature expiry.
